parts.title: Part 1 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.

parts.title: Part 2 · Listening
parts.instr: Listen to your teacher’s questions. Choose the correct answer (a, b or c).

opts.b: a long journey on water or in space

parts.title: Part 3 · Gap fill
parts.instr: Write ONE word in each gap.

items.q: I reckon it’s ____ likely to snow later today.
How on ____ did the Egyptians build those pyramids, Dad?
Desmond stepped onto the bathroom ____ and smiled; he had lost a whole kilogram since joining the gym.
I reckon we might as ____ walk home. There’s no bus for at least half an hour.
I can’t believe we’re flying home tomorrow. If ____ we had a couple of days more to enjoy the beach!
I didn’t want to come to Italy but, now ____ I’m here, I love it.
I want to make a good impression ____ your parents when I meet them.
In addition ____ the local currency, this hotel will accept the euro and dollar for payments.
Don’t ____ attention to anything George says. He doesn’t know what he’s talking about.
After ____ an explanation of what had happened to the police officer, we were allowed to go home.
Getting a good degree would enable ____ your career with more freedom.
Jarmila set her 800m world record so long ago that many people now think it may never be ____ .
Some people are capable ____ lying without feeling any guilt at all.
Don’t ____ your temper with Billy. He wasn’t trying to ruin the sofa; it was a science experiment.
I know it’s bad, but I can’t help ____ . Dad’s such an awful cook.

parts.title: Part 5 · Error correction
parts.instr: Correct the mistake in each sentence. You can add one word, take out one word, or change one word. Type the whole corrected sentence.

items.text: Use this cloth; it should asorbe most of the liquid. Then we’ll pour salt over it, and just hope Mum never looks at that bit of sofa.
You should make this decision alone, as much as I’m concerned. I’m really worried that other people may not consider what’s in your best interest.
I pay my rent in advance but get paid by my company in areas. Is that fair?
Fernanda had no idea what to say. David’s question had taken her completely with surprise.
I’m quite envious for Joe’s ability to speak so easily in Spanish.
Robby grew to love being in the army, beyond all because it was exciting.
You are responsible of your own mistakes, Juan, nobody else.
I just told Tim to go and play in the garden; he was making a real nuisance with himself in the kitchen.
As a secondary school teacher in a tough part of the city, I have to be prepared to bring my foot down at times.
Hugh’s tall, but only in relation with the rest of our family; we’re all pretty small.

parts.text: A hall is a large room. People usually say “p” instead of “pence”. The three forms of “forbid” are “forbid, forbade, forbidden”. The word “wonder” means to ask yourself questions. The word “slight” means small, and usually unimportant. A heap is an untidy pile. The three forms of “dig” are “dig, dug, dug”. A three-piece suit consists of trousers, a jacket and a waistcoat. My great-grandparents are all buried in the same cemetery. The freezing point of water is zero degrees centigrade. A cat’s foot is called a paw. Why don’t we kill two birds with one stone?

teacher.1: How many degrees are there in a right angle?
teacher.3: What does a dog do with a bone?
teacher.4: What colour clothes do European people usually wear for a funeral?
teacher.5: What’s the noun of the verb “admire”?
teacher.6: What do we get when ice melts?
teacher.7: What do we call a man who works in a mine?
teacher.8: What do we use to iron our clothes?

1: Use this cloth; it should absorb most of the liquid. Then we’ll pour salt over it, and just hope Mum never looks at that bit of sofa.
2: You should make this decision alone, as far as I’m concerned. I’m really worried that other people may not consider what’s in your best interest.
3: I pay my rent in advance but get paid by my company in arrears. Is that fair?
4: Fernanda had no idea what to say. David’s question had taken her completely by surprise.
5: I’m quite envious of Joe’s ability to speak so easily in Spanish.
6: Robby grew to love being in the army, above all because it was exciting.
7: You are responsible for your own mistakes, Juan, nobody else.
8: I just told Tim to go and play in the garden; he was making a real nuisance of himself in the kitchen.
9: As a secondary school teacher in a tough part of the city, I have to be prepared to put my foot down at times.
10: Hugh’s tall, but only in relation to the rest of our family; we’re all pretty small.
